page_title: MON 0-1 ANG | Monaco v Angers 01/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' Substitution. Ibrahima Niane makes way for Bamba Dieng (Angers).
90+3' The game is interrupted as Carlens Arcus (Angers) is flagged offside.
90+3' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat.
90+1' Himad Abdelli (Angers) takes the corner with a short pass.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' Abdelatif Kherradji has issued a yellow card to Pierrick Capelle (Angers).
87' Shots on target – 3:3.
84' Adi Hutter has decided to substitute Caio Henrique and he is replaced by Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco).
80' Saimon Bouabre (Monaco) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Lamine Camara.
79' Himad Abdelli (Angers) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play. Monaco will have a throw-in.
77' Krepin Diatta (Monaco) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Abdelatif Kherradji blows his whistle for a foul.
75' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
72' Alexandre Dujeux is forced to make a change. Farid El Melali (Angers) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Esteban Lepaul.
72' It is time for a substitution. Pierrick Capelle (Angers) is on for Jean-Eudes Aholou.
70' Great save! Breel Embolo (Monaco) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom left corner was brilliantly saved by Yahia Fofana.
67' A poorly executed mid-range free kick by Lamine Camara (Monaco) as he fails to deliver a decent cross. The ball goes out of play and Angers will have a goal kick.
65' Ibrahima Niane (Angers) commits a rough challenge and Abdelatif Kherradji blows his whistle for an infringement.
64' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
63' Krepin Diatta (Monaco) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
61' Substitution. Jim Allevinah is replaced by Yassine Belkhdim (Angers).
60' Jordan Lefort (Angers) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
59' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
56' The ball possession is 62:38.
54' Jordan Lefort (Angers) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Abdelatif Kherradji blows his whistle for a foul.
51' Wilfried Singo (Monaco) takes a short pass in his stride inside the box, but hits a poor shot at goal that goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Angers will have a goal kick.
51' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
48' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Angers.
46' Half-time substitution. Adi Hutter decided to make a change. George Ilenikhena is replaced by Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) brings an opponent down and Abdelatif Kherradji interrupts the game.
45+2' 3:7 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
45+1' Himad Abdelli (Angers) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
44' Wilfried Singo (Monaco) commits a rough foul. Abdelatif Kherradji stops the game and makes a call.
42' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco).
41' Caio Henrique (Monaco) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
40' Himad Abdelli (Angers) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Abdelatif Kherradji blows for a foul.
39' A cross into the box from Caio Henrique (Monaco) is cleared.

37' Ambitious effort from Caio Henrique (Monaco). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Angers.
36' Krepin Diatta (Monaco) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
35' Florent Hanin (Angers) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
32' The game is interrupted now, Krepin Diatta (Monaco) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
32' Florent Hanin (Angers) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
29' 0 - 1 Goal - 0:1! Jean-Eudes Aholou (Angers) gets a shot away from the edge of the box and scores into the roof of the net. Jim Allevinah provided an assist for the goal.
27' It looks like Jordan Lefort (Angers) saw red with that tackle. Abdelatif Kherradji won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
26' Lamine Camara (Monaco) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Yahia Fofana has no trouble gathering it.

26' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Monaco.
24' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
21' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
19' Abdelatif Kherradji has a clear sight and sees a foul from Krepin Diatta (Monaco).
17' The foul by Lamine Camara (Monaco) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Abdelatif Kherradji.
14' Jim Allevinah (Angers) blows an opportunity as he sends a rebound from just outside of the box narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Monaco will have a goal kick.
12' A dangerous looking corner kick from Caio Henrique (Monaco) is cleared to safety by the defence.
12' Jean-Eudes Aholou (Angers) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
11' Jean-Eudes Aholou (Angers) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
9' Carlens Arcus (Angers) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
8' Ibrahima Niane (Angers) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
5' Abdelatif Kherradji blows his whistle after Jim Allevinah (Angers) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
3' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Angers comes to nothing.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Angers will take the kick-off.
Abdelatif Kherradji will referee today's match.
